detail.longDescription: FediSuite 2.0 is live! 🎉 Your Fediverse Management Platform If you run several Fediverse accounts, you might know the feeling: an idea is sitting in a note somewhere, a scheduled post is in another tab, and the numbers end up somewhere else again. I wanted to bring it all together. The new # Planner takes a post from the first idea to publication. # Drafts save automatically. In the # ContentCalendar , you can see scheduled posts by month or week and move them to another time. # Campaigns group posts around a topic or event. Coloured # labels help you stay organised without ever appearing as hashtags. After publishing, the searchable # archive helps you find and reuse your work. You can turn older posts into new drafts, collect evergreen content and spot posts that have become interesting again. # ContentAnalysis compares formats, text lengths, links and more. Hints based on your own data appear while you write, and the # calendar shows promising time slots. For Mastodon-compatible accounts, the new # CommunityAnalysis shows which accounts interact with your posts, who is new and who keeps coming back. # Favourites , # boosts and # replies stay separate. These are ideas to try, not promises of more reach. There’s a lot of work under the hood, too: access tokens for connected accounts are now stored encrypted, sessions expire, and one-time links have better protection. FediSuite is still open source, free to use, without ads or trackers, and available to self-host. The web app supports more than 20 Fediverse platforms. Give it a try: https://www. fedisuite.com/ I’d love to hear your thoughts and ideas. And if something isn’t working quite right, please tell me that too. 💜 # FediSuite # FediSuite2 # Fediverse # OpenSource # selfhosted # mastodon # friendica # pixelfed # bizzfed # peertube # vutuv # loops
